sealed_boundary.statement: Published P7-free List-3 restriction palettes cannot be directly compiled into CSZ source-list reductions merely by storing their bulk singleton assignments in X0'.
sealed_boundary.reason: For every unseeded vertex, CSZ L_P ignores X0' neighbors and is determined only by colored seed neighbors; axiom (v) and Lemma 10 use that source list to determine X/Y membership.
sealed_boundary.consequence: An externally reduced palette of size <=2 may still correspond to source list size 3 and therefore to source Y.
sealed_boundary.required_extra_for_any_future_bypass: A new source-specific theorem must certify bounded seed witnesses, safe source removal, polynomially compressible extra color commitments, or another exact mechanism that changes/removes the source-Y obligation.

what_is_not_sealed: No theorem that every source-specific List-3 compilation is impossible.
No lower bound against all polynomial algorithms.
No statement that Bonomo et al. List-3 machinery is unusable; its B1A auxiliary use remains valid.
No promotion of the full-component quotient candidate.
